quest.title: Neko Is a Cat: Shrine Recipe
quest.description: Neko, "Provisional Head Priestess of the Asase Shrine," seems to have business with you...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x30000

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Ah, you're here. Great timing. I have need of aid.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Thanks to you, the shrine has been greatly improved, and we can expect the humans to return very soon indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: I have been instructing the little ones to maintain a dignified bearing and not abase themselves before humans.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, they are too used to running wild and will not listen to instruction.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Nonetheless, I have a cunning plan.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A cunning plan?

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: When I was still very, very young, I too enjoyed playing everywhere. In an effort to bring me in line along with the other cats, Hibiki would make a most delicious dish.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: D—Delicious, you say...!

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Whenever that meal was served, the cats would come running in from trees and rooftops alike. No matter how hot it was, or how scalded our tongues got, we could not resist it.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Hibiki would make a huge pot of it every time, and humans and cats would partake together. Even those who visited the shrine would get a share.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Ah, but Domeki... Tsk, that glutton. He would always eat so very much. A more undignified sight I have never seen.

choices.text: So...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Very good, your comprehension is excellent. Yes, I am asking you to make a dish.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Not to doubt your wisdom...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But do you really know how this dish should be made?

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Meow, meow?

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: I—Is not leaving such matters to you the very point of this exercise? Must I do everything myself?

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: ...Ah, but that dish was truly a thing of wonder! Even after wandering far off, or having spent years and years without it, I still remember its flavor...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Well, {NICKNAME}, looks like this is a job for us, eh? It's for the shrine's sake, after all!

choices.text: What's in that meal?

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Of course I remember. Fish meat, animal meat, water-grown grass, and white rice.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, so that's Fish, Raw Meat, Seagrass, and Rice, huh... How was it made, then?

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: I do not recall.

choices.text: ...Looks like we'll have to ask a chef.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sure, but... Where do we find a chef who knows how to make cat food? Hmm... Let's ask Taisuke and Etsuko. Maybe they'll know what to do.

choices.text: Let's go ask those two adventurers.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh yeah, that's right! Taisuke and Etsuko are adventurers, so they might know something.

choices.text: You're so easily read, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Come on, Paimon's a friend to cats! Now, Neko, do you still remember the ingredients that went into that dish?

choices.text: You want me to make you some food?

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: Miss Etsuko, where should we go next?

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Phew... I think we'll rest for a while...

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Hmm? It's you. Is there anything we can do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We need to find a reliable chef...

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: You're looking for a chef? On Seirai Island?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, here's the thing. Neko would like us to...

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: Huh. So Lady Neko wants you to prepare some food, is that right?

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: Ah, darn it! If only I had some skill in cooking...

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: In other words, you'd like a chef who can help you figure out "how to make something a cat would like out of these ingredients," right?

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Let me think... A chef... A chef...

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Well, why don't you try going to Inazuma City and looking for Kiminami Anna at Kiminami Restaurant?

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: She's a very nice person, and she's good at cooking as well. She should be able to help you out.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks, we'll go look for her.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: No need to thank us. Off you go, then, Taisuke and I still need to lay some plans for future exploration.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Hehe, well, I hope that this shrine really does thrive.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Otherwise, the hard work that you and Neko put into fixing it might go to waste...

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Hello, welcome to Kiminami Restaurant. Would you like something?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So I need to make Neko a meal...

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: "Neko?" ... Might that be a cat's name, by any chance?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You know who Neko is?

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: No. I just thought that it was a fitting name for a cat.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's some strong intuition you've got there...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Never mind that for now. This is how it happened...

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: There's... an Asase Shrine on Seirai Island, and that shrine is home to a talking cat!? And that cat asked you to make it a meal?

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Is... Is that really true? I've never heard of such a thing!

choices.text: Surely as I live and breathe...

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Seirai Island, was it? I'll go there for sure if I get the chance!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Uh, so, about Neko's meal...

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Ah, right... I nearly forgot about that. Let me think...

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Hmm, a dish that a cat would enjoy, huh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is it gonna be difficult?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's going to be difficult, isn't it?

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: This is a challenge to the Kiminami family name! I'm going to overcome it, no matter what!

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Now then. I believe that Fish, Raw Meat, Seagrass, and Rice will make for a dish that even cats will fall over themselves to get a taste of. Leave it to me, Traveler!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: P—Paimon wants some too...

choices.text: Actually, me too...

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: No problem!

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Let me consider how I'm going to structure this recipe. In the meantime, help me prepare three servings of Seagrass.

choices.text: You got it.

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: It'll be in your hands then. Just three servings will do. Once you find them, come back and give them to me.

choices.text: Have you figured it out already?

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: I have some thoughts, but they haven't completely taken shape yet...

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Just help me get those three servings of Seagrass first. Thank you very much.

choices.text: We'll leave it in your hands, then.
You can go have a look yourself.

talks.objective: Give three servings of Seagrass to Kiminami Anna

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: This smell... You've done it, then?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That we have.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Meow, meow! Wonderful! Allow me to have a taste.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Mmm, it's somewhat different from how Hibiki used to make it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: I—It should be pretty good. C'mon, let's have a go at it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, this is great!

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: ...Meow.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Is Neko unhappy that it tastes different from how this Hibiki person used to make it?)

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: It's very good. You are most reliable indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Glad you enjoyed it.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: It is quite different from how Hibiki used to make it, yes.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: But when I ate it, the feeling it gave me was the same as the feeling of eating together with Hibiki.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Why is this so, human? Are you humans capable of some strange magic?

choices.text: It's just been a while since someone made you food.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: ...Still, you have my thanks. Long years it has been since I last tasted something this good.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: The little ones will love it as well. Could you please bring this meal to them as well?

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Since I enjoy it, they should too. Perhaps they will be more obedient after eating such a wonderful meal...

choices.text: It's probably the passion of the person who made it.

talks.objective: Give three servings of Seagrass to Kiminami Anna

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Great! Give me a moment. I think... I think I know what to do now!

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: It's done!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, that smells awesome! Paimon really wants to try some...

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: What shall we call this? Hmm... Since it's for a talking cat, let's call this the Invigorating Kitty Meal!

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Well then! Here's your dish to go.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Ah, yes, and let me write the recipe down for you as well.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Woohoo! Guess {NICKNAME}-made Kitty Meals are on the menu in the near future!

choices.text: What are you, Paimon, a cat?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, that's rude! Good food is a universal language, don't you know?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, thanks a bunch, Miss Kiminami!

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: It's alright, don't worry! Just take this meal and the recipe as a present for Neko.

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: I'll be sure to head down to that Asase Shrine to pay her a visit once I find the time.

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Alright, off you go now. Don't keep Neko waiting.

choices.text: Thank you.

talks.objective: Give the Delicious Invigorating Kitty Meal to the kittens

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: I shall leave the cooking to you.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: And when you are done, eat it together with us.

talks.objective: Give the Delicious Invigorating Kitty Meal to the kittens

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Something the matter? If not, head over to the city and look for Miss Kiminami Anna.

talks.objective: Give the Delicious Invigorating Kitty Meal to the kittens

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only I new how to make food...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Have you brought the meal to those little ones?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They absolutely loved it.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Is that so? Wonderful, wonderful. Meow, meow...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: It has been too long since I ate something so wondrous.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Meow meow, meow... Though I now need neither food nor water, the taste of a meal with rice is always too great a temptation...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: That little one was named Meshi, precisely because that is the best thing I could think of in all the world.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, what was the name of the dish that Hibiki would make?

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: A name? Dishes need names?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This one's called the "Invigorating Kitty Meal," you know.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: What a complicated name. Still, I do not hate it.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: ...And you are right. Meals are good things, and all good things should have names.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Meow, meow, I will ask Hibiki when she returns. You can make her your dish then, too...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: And she will make you hers. Then, you shall be able to eat two different yet delicious dishes.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Indeed, that is all the more reason for me to restore this shrine. When Hibiki returns, we shall all eat together.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Thank you. This is most delicious. Meow meow.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: How is it? Have you found the three servings of Seagrass yet?
